anime_multiverse.configuration.devilCano: On: each devil of the Devil Contract is drawn with its own model, painted sheet and glow, built from the design of that devil in its story (Liebe, Lucifero, the Fox Devil, Sebastian, the God Hand, and the rest of the 26), in the trial fight and in the summoning. Off: every devil shares the generic horned brute.
anime_multiverse.configuration.devilRitu: On: the devil that rises from the summoning circle is the full-size devil model of the trial (the same model and size, wings and horns attached to its body), climbing out of the circle with a burst of dust. Off: the earlier figure (the player-model look, or the Blender mesh).
